comparison.objective: Refit a desktop-PC cover, versus remove four installed-insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-panel alignment and cover engagement, not recessed coaxial tooling, bimanual hammering, or fragment collection.

comparison.reason: Panel refitting does not test impact-driven notch fracture or preservation of retained coils.
